# Standard license text sources

These templates supply the standard license wording when an exact-version npm
tarball omits a standalone license file. The generator substitutes the
package-specific copyright notice recorded in
`../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_OVERRIDES.json`.

- MIT: https://spdx.org/licenses/MIT.html
- ISC: https://spdx.org/licenses/ISC.html

Package-specific copyright notices must be grounded in the exact npm package
metadata or upstream source listed in the override entry. Do not add an
override for an unknown license or an unverified copyright holder.
